_readme: CENTERING GROUND TRUTH (Oct 16 2026). Front border widths in source-photo pixels, read by eye
from ruler-overlaid edge strips cut around the engine's detected outline (scripts/_tmp-edge-ruler.ts).
Each strip: cut edge on the left, interior to the right, 10px ticks, labels every 50px.
Widths are the distance from the cut edge to the first printed element of the border's inner edge.
Precision ~5px; confidence: high = clean border and sharp photo, medium = readable, low = glare/sleeve/soft.
Ratios: left/(left+right), top/(top+bottom). null = that axis has no measurable border on this design.
Skipped (no border or painted edge): Smaug (borderless), Ace ST30 (full art), Thorpe 94 Ultra (full bleed),
Berra 50s Bowman (painted), Aaron (inner frame ambiguous), Evans Strata (chrome frame + glare), Mew ex (sleeve),
GPK x3 (600px photos). Olsen top/bottom agrees with the Aug 26 independent edge-detector read (41/87).
